description: Full detail for one Earth Search collection: title, description, licence, providers, spatial and temporal extent, and the asset keys (bands, thumbnails, metadata) its items carry. AUTHORITATIVE for which bands a mission delivers here and how far the archive goes back. Get valid ids from earth_search_collections — they differ from the ids other STAC catalogues use for the same mission.

collection_id.description: Collection id exactly as listed, e.g. "sentinel-2-c1-l2a", "landsat-c2-l2", "sentinel-1-grd".

name: earth_search_collection
title: Earth Search Collection
